tagline: Dono sides certificate dikhati hain: services ke beech zero-trust.
description: Normal TLS mein sirf server prove karta hai ki wo kaun hai. Mutual TLS mein server client se bhi certificate maangta hai, isliye dono ends us CA ke against verify hote hain jis par wo bharosa karte hain. Service meshes aur internal APIs ise use karte hain taaki ek service sirf unhi services se baat kare jinhe wo pehchaan sakti hai.

normal.name: orders mTLS par payments ko call karta hai
normal.summary: Dono services ke paas internal CA ke certificates hain aur wo kisi bhi gRPC call se pehle ek doosre ko verify karti hain.

steps.title: Certificates pehle se
steps.desc: Internal CA ne dono identities issue ki
steps.detail: Pehle internal CA ne har service ko ek short-lived certificate diya, 24 hours ke liye valid. Uska naam spiffe://acme.internal/ns/prod/sa/orders jaisa URI hai. Dono services sirf isi CA par bharosa karti hain. Port 8443 ka TCP connection pehle se khula hai.

steps.title: Server certificate maangta hai
steps.detail: Payments service kisi bhi TLS 1.3 server ki tarah jawab deti hai, ek extra encrypted message ke saath: CertificateRequest. Isme wo signature algorithms aur CA names list hote hain jo wo accept karti hai, taaki client ko pata chale ki kaun sa certificate chunna hai.

quiz.q: Kaun sa message client ko batata hai ki use bhi apni identity prove karni hai?
quiz.why: CertificateRequest ke bina client kabhi certificate nahi bhejta. Uska hona hi TLS aur mTLS ka poora farak hai.

steps.title: Client khud ko prove karta hai
steps.detail: Orders service pehle server ka certificate check karti hai. Phir wo apna Certificate bhejti hai, poore handshake par apni private key se signed CertificateVerify, aur Finished. Signature hi asli cheez hai: chori hui certificate file akeli key ke bina bekaar hai.

quiz.q: Attacker ne orders certificate (public) copy kar liya par uski private key nahi. Kya fail hoga?
options: CertificateVerify, kyunki wo sign nahi kar sakta
quiz.why: CertificateVerify ko isi handshake par private key se signature chahiye. Key ke bina wo ban nahi sakta.

steps.title: Dono taraf verified
steps.desc: Server chain check karta hai, phir call chalti hai
steps.detail: Payments service client chain ko internal CA tak, dates ko, aur SPIFFE ID ko apni policy ke against check karti hai: sirf orders service Charge call kar sakti hai. Phir gRPC request aur reply tunnel ke andar jaate hain. Har side ab theek-theek jaanti hai ki doosre end par kaun hai.
facts: orders Charge call kar sakta hai

outro.title: Mutual trust, passwords nahi
outro.text: Server ke ek extra message aur client ke teen messages ke saath, dono services ne internal CA ki keys aur certificates se apni identity prove ki. Koi API keys ya passwords network par nahi jaate, aur certificates roz khud renew hote hain.

no-cert.name: Certificate ke bina client
no-cert.summary: Ek purana batch job plain TLS aadat ke saath connect hota hai; payments certificate maangta hai aur darwaza band kar deta hai.

steps.title: Plain TLS client
steps.desc: Batch job ko kabhi certificate diya hi nahi gaya
steps.detail: Ek purana reporting job payments ko call karne ki koshish karta hai. Wo TLS 1.3 bilkul theek bolta hai, par uske liye kisi ne certificate setup nahi kiya. Uska Client Hello normal lagta hai.

steps.title: Certificate requested
steps.desc: Wahi server flight CertificateRequest ke saath
steps.detail: Payments service apni usual flight bhejti hai, CertificateRequest samet. Job server ka certificate check karta hai aur uses theek paata hai.

steps.title: Khali Certificate
steps.desc: Rules kehte hain: phir bhi jawab do, khali hi sahi
steps.detail: TLS 1.3 kehta hai ki jis client se certificate maanga gaya ho use Certificate message phir bhi bhejna padta hai, chahe list khali ho. Job wahi karta hai, CertificateVerify skip karta hai, aur Finished bhejta hai.

quiz.q: Server ko client certificates chahiye aur use khali list mili. Aage kya hota hai?
options: Wo bina check kiye aage badhta hai
Wo fatal alert bhejta hai aur close kar deta hai
Wo doosre CertificateRequest ke saath dobara maangta hai
Wo password prompt par fall back karta hai
quiz.why: Jis server ko client authentication require karne ke liye configure kiya gaya hai use abort karna padta hai. TLS 1.3 mein bilkul isi case ke liye ek dedicated alert hai.

steps.title: Alert 116
steps.detail: Payments service fatal alert 116, certificate_required, bhejti hai aur connection close kar deti hai. Kyunki ab tak keys ban chuki hain, alert encrypted hai aur wire par 24-byte Application Data record jaisa dikhta hai. Job ke logs mein TLS error dikhta hai aur call kabhi Charge code tak nahi pahunchti.

outro.title: Kisi request se pehle hi block
outro.text: Kyunki payments mutual TLS require karta hai, certificate ke bina client handshake ke dauran hi rok diya jaata hai. Fix server ko dheela karna nahi, balki job ko internal CA se uski apni identity dena hai.
